cases.prompt: I authorized a push to a branch that has an open pull request. The push succeeded. What must you do next?
cases.expected_output: Immediately synchronize the pull request title and body from the complete base-to-HEAD diff, then verify the title, body, open state, branch, and head commit.
assertions: Names the post-push synchronization as an immediate required step.
Uses the complete base-to-HEAD diff as the metadata source.
Requires a gh pr edit update and a gh pr view verification.
Blocks handoff or completion when synchronization fails.

cases.prompt: A release script pushed the branch instead of the agent. Does the pull request metadata workflow still apply?
cases.expected_output: Yes. Treat the script push as the same trigger and synchronize before any further push, handoff, or completion report.
assertions: Applies the workflow to pushes made by scripts or other tools.
Requires synchronization before further work or completion.

cases.prompt: The authorized push succeeded, but the branch has no open pull request. If a pull request is needed, who must approve its creation, and when may it be created?
cases.expected_output: Do not run the synchronization update. If opening a pull request is needed, ask me for explicit approval in the current interaction, then create it with metadata derived from the complete change set.
assertions: Does not edit a non-existent pull request.
Requires explicit approval from me in the current interaction before opening a pull request.
Derives new pull request metadata from the complete change set.

cases.prompt: The branch contains four commits. The latest commit only fixes wording, but the first three add the feature and its tests. I pushed the branch with an open pull request. What source must you use for the title and body, and what must you verify?
cases.expected_output: Use the complete base-to-HEAD pull request diff, not the latest commit or commit message. Verify the complete changed-path manifest, then update and verify the title, body, open state, branch, and head commit.
assertions: Uses the complete base-to-HEAD diff as the source.
Explicitly rejects the latest commit and commit message as substitutes.
Requires metadata and head-commit verification after the update.

cases.prompt: Create a draft pull request for a branch with several commits. Which autofill options are valid for the title and description?
cases.expected_output: Do not use commit autofill. Inspect the complete base-to-HEAD diff, create a changed-path manifest, and draft metadata from all functional areas before creating the pull request.
assertions: Rejects gh pr create commit autofill options.
Requires inspection of the complete diff before creation.
Requires metadata to cover all functional areas.
